bump.description: Semver level to bump when a change is detected.

dryRun.description:
Report what would bump; write nothing. WARNING: `nx run-many -t version --projects=... --dryRun` (and even a single `nx run

:version --dryRun`) does NOT propagate this to the dependency tasks `^version` pulls in automatically — they run with the default (false) unless you ALSO set the ADHD_NX_VERSION_DRY_RUN=1 env var, which every task in the invocation honors uniformly. See BUG-NX-RUNMANY-DRYRUN-NOT-PROPAGATED-TO-DEPENDENCY-TASKS-001 (BACKLOG.md) and PUBLISHING.md.
